comment: kiln.knowledge (native/services/quests, kiln-quests.dll): the game's knowledge registry (G38Knowledge), the KnowledgeTriggerQueue apply, the journal, the NPC registry's unlock state, the dialogue-line knowledge path and the client's knowledge input. Captured from the game's own code: the queue apply 0x9a0830 and its per-operation apply 0x9a0670 (world part) / 0x9a4a80 (player part), the player-block store 0x9a08a0, the change-list append 0x99fa50, update_knowledge_system_server 0x1bdc90, trigger_quest_rewards 0x1bd9e0 (journal getter, query evaluator), npc_unlock_state_server 0x1fa330, unlock_knowledge_from_dialog_option_input 0x1fb380 (FindDialogLine 0x1f0ef0) and handle_knowledge_trigger_input 0x1bc140. Reuses players/KnowledgeQueuePush, players/KnowledgeIndex, players/KnowledgePlayerContext and the players/know.* block layout (players.json, progression.json). Evidence: docs/re/quests.md, docs/kiln/services/knowledge.md. Service: kiln.knowledge.
